data.name: Murtazaan
data.gender_notes: Murtazaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Murtazaan is a name that signifies the victory and help of Allah. The name Murtazaan carries the meaning “Help and Victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murtazaan usually hope their child will grow to embody help and victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Murtazaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Help and Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtazaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مرتضaan
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الرضا، الشخص الذي ارتضاه الله تعالى ورضيه، يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بقبول ورضا الله تعالى، ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالرضا والموافقة الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: مرتضaan
in_urdu.meaning: مرتضیٰ، اللہ تعالیٰ کا رضا حاصل کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام رضا کے معنی میں ہے، یعنی وہ شخص جسے اللہ تعالیٰ نے رضا دیا ہو، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر اردوگو بولنے والے ممالک میں۔

in_hindi.name: मुर्तज़ान
in_hindi.meaning: मुर्तज़ा, अल्लाह की رضा प्राप्त करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अल्लाह की رضा प्राप्त करना, यह नाम हिंदूस्तान में मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रचलित है, और इसका उच्चारण मुर्तज़ान किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: مرتضaan
in_pashto.meaning: مرتضی، د الله رضا ترلاسه کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د رضا په معنی دی، هغه څوک چې د الله تعالی رضا یې ترلاسه کړې، دا نوم د پښتنو او افغانانو په دودیزو نومونو کې شامل دی.

in_english.name: Murtazaan
in_english.meaning: One who gains Allah's satisfaction and approval
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-Dh-Y', meaning 'to be pleased' or 'to be satisfied', Murtazaan signifies a person who has earned Allah's pleasure and consent, reflecting a highly esteemed spiritual status in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Murtazaan holds a significant cultural importance in the Islamic world. It is associated with the Prophet of Islam, Hazrat Imam Ali, who is a revered figure in Islamic history. Imam Ali is known as 'Lion of God', 'Lion of Allah', and 'Murtadha', which is another form of the name Murtazaan. This name reflects his valiant and courageous nature. The name has been passed down through generations, and many Muslims today proudly bear this name as a reminder of their rich cultural heritage and lineage.
data.spiritual_significance: Murtazaan, which means 'victorious one' or 'help from Allah', holds a deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. The name is a constant reminder that Allah is always with us, helping us through the trials and tribulations of life. It serves as a source of inspiration and motivation for believers to strive towards religious and spiritual growth and to trust in Allah's divine plan for their lives. The name Murtazaan is a powerful reminder of the preserving power of Allah and the strength that can be derived from seeking His help and guidance.
